text:
Priya: Heads up — Luminex reporting 95th pctl tail latency spikes from ~220ms -> ~480ms over the last 48h. Looks correlated with larger batch sizes during bursts. Can we put together a proactive plan (quantize, model swap, routing) to reduce cost/latency without risking quality? :warning:
Mateo: Thanks, checking metrics now. What model + config are they on today?
Priya: Theyre on redwood/gpt-3b-v1, float16, batch_size=32, routing policy: regional-us-west primary, us-east fallback. QPS ~12/s but very bursty around 11:00 PST.
Mateo: Quick idea — try int8 quantization of the same model (v1-int8) and a temporary routing preference favoring us-east for interactive customers. Canary 5% traffic to start.
Sophia: int8 should reduce per-token latency ~20-35% on our A100 fleet, but we need to validate generation quality. Recommend an A/B eval on a small seed set plus KV/prefix caching where applicable. Also consider lowering max_batch for VIP routes.
Priya: Customer reported a slight uptick in hallucination cases for some edge prompts — theyre sensitive. CS wants a clear rollback/quality threshold before we flip anything.
Mateo: Agreed. Proposed canary plan:
```yaml
routing:
  primary: us-east
  fallback: us-west
canary:
  model: redwood/gpt-3b-v1-int8
  weight: 0.05
  duration: 48h
monitoring:
  quality_eval_set: /evals/luminex/seed50
  thresholds:
    quality_delta_pct: 1.5
    p95_latency_ms: 350
```
EngOps (Bot): Canary scheduled for 2026-04-02 06:00 UTC. Alerts will post to #eng-runtime and #customer-success. Canary config ID: canary-3550004444. :rocket:
Priya: I'll share the plan with the Luminex CSM + AM and capture immediate feedback; flagging renewal risk if costs spike.
Sophia: Also recommend a temporary VIP override: set max_batch=8 and route VIP traffic to us-east until canary shows stable quality.
Mateo: I'll open the rollout PR with perf bench artifacts and attach a script to compute the quality delta automatically. ETA ~6h.
Priya: Perfect — please ping when PR merges and when the canary starts. Thanks everyone :pray:
